name: vek_order
question: Vek attack order is board-list (insertion) order: a Vek that kills another first cancels its attack.
mission: any mission without an environment (env_class Env_Null), player turn 1-3, not the last turn
observe: The Firefly at (1,3), listed first, shoots right and kills the Hornet at (3,3) before the Hornet attacks.
Mech 0 at (3,4) keeps full HP; the phase log's 'selected' entries show only the Firefly firing.
